theme_strategy.rationale: Matches modern retail digital signage admin panels, reduces eye strain for store managers, and makes neon orange/green accents pop.

rules: Avoid Inter for headings, use Manrope for a modern retail/technical look.
Ensure tight tracking for large headings.
Overlines and labels must be uppercase, tiny, and wide spacing.

guidelines: Use Electric Orange (#FF5F1F) as the primary CTA and active state indicator.
Use Mint Green (#10B981) exclusively for 'Online' status, success states, and positive analytics trends.
Maintain a deep obsidian background, avoiding pure black. Never use pure #000000.

admin_dashboard.grid: Bento Grid Mode B (High Density). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6
admin_dashboard.spacing: Generous internal padding for cards (p-6 or p-8)
admin_dashboard.surface: Flat Solid surfaces with 1px subtle borders. Avoid soft UI shadows.

z_index.z-10: Gradient overlay at bottom (bg-gradient-to-t from-black/90 via-black/50 to-transparent)

motion.admin: Micro-interactions: Hover states (-translate-y-1), subtle shadows, and staggered entrance animations for grid items.
motion.tv_display: Smooth crossfade between media items using Framer Motion. Subtle Ken Burns scale effect (1.0 to 1.05) on images over duration.
motion.rules: Disable or reduce motion based on prefers-reduced-motion media query.

components.cards: Cardless or sharp rectangular styles. Use 1px borders.
components.buttons: Sharp or slightly rounded rectangles. Hover state must lighten color.
components.tables: Dense, high-contrast rows. Explicit status dots (Green = Online, Red = Offline).
components.icons: lucide-react for standard icons, use size 20px-24px.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Use APCA guidelines.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Multi-view Application: Establish React Router early to distinguish /admin (Dashboard) and /display (TV Signage).
2. TV Display Restrictions: The /display route MUST have 'cursor-none', 'h-screen w-screen', 'overflow-hidden'. There should be absolutely no scrollbars or navigation here.
3. TV Display Layers: Implement absolute positioning for the ticker (bottom) and clock/logo (top) over the media player.
4. Ticker: Install and use 'react-fast-marquee' for the running text. Ensure its container has a heavy dark gradient behind it so text is readable against bright images.
5. Theme: Apply the dark mode HSL variables strictly. Set primary to Electric Orange and accent/success to Mint Green.
6. TV Display Media: Build a slideshow that loops through images/videos. Use framer-motion (AnimatePresence) for smooth crossfades. If video, trigger play() automatically.
7. Admin Dashboard: Build a responsive Bento grid for the main overview (Stat cards for Online/Offline). Use Shadcn tables for TV Management.
8. Media Manager: Build a grid for uploaded assets. Use the placeholder image URLs provided.
9. Playlist Builder: Needs drag-and-drop or simple up/down arrow reordering with duration inputs.
10. Component UI: Use Shadcn components (Dialog, Table, Select) for admin forms.
11. Never use fully transparent backgrounds for UI surfaces; use Glassmorphism for floating admin panels or solid #141414 for cards.
12. File extensions: Use .js and .jsx, NOT .tsx (unless the project is specifically configured for TSX).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate (e.g., sticky headers).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add text-align: center to the root CSS.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent relies on provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholder text/URLs like via.placeholder.com.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
